Up to two spirit stones are catalysts (the furnace formation draws on them): each Low stone +%s%% success, each Mid or better +%s%% success and +%s on the quality roll. kultivator.screen.help.batu_roh.title: Spirit Stones
kultivator.screen.help.batu_roh: Spirit stones come in four grades: Low, Mid, High and Supreme; 9 craft into one of the next grade and one breaks back into 9. From Qi Refining, ores you break yourself (survival, no Silk Touch) sometimes give a Low stone: 1.5%% for coal up to 15%% for diamond, more in rich spirit veins. Chests of old structures, the wandering trader (2 emeralds for 3), tier-3 demonic beasts and sect expeditions give them too. Uses: hold them in the off hand while meditating as fuel (Low one every 30 s for ×1.5 up to Supreme one every 10 min for ×3; at a full bottleneck the gain goes to Stored Qi); sneak-use one outside meditation for qi at once (Low +30 up to Supreme: full qi and ×3 regeneration for 60 s); sneak-use one on a protective formation's lodestone (Low +20 min, Mid +3 h, High +24 h, Supreme fills it to 48 h; amethyst still stops at 2 h); hold High or Supreme stones in the off hand when a breakthrough succeeds for +0.03 or +0.08 quality per stone (at most 4 stones and +0.16; a failed or cancelled attempt keeps them). They are alchemy catalysts and the Mission Hall pays 0.5 / 4.5 / 40 / 300 CP. Sources: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 131, 169, 214, 1152, 1155-1156 and the donghua season 2 episodes 1-2; Renegade Immortal ch. 19 and 329; Invincible ch. 1392; A Will Eternal ch. 79.
kultivator.screen.help.tanaman_roh.title: Spirit Herbs
kultivator.screen.help.tanaman_roh: From Qi Refining, a plant you break yourself may hide a spirit herb; every spot rolls once per day and gives at most one herb a day, so replanting or bone meal gains nothing, and you find at most 12 herbs a day. Every find drains the local vein a little, so a picked-over region yields less often. Spirit Grass hides in grass and ferns of the Overworld; Ninecurl Spirit Ginseng in ripe carrots, potatoes and beetroots (twice as often in jungle, taiga, old growth and cherry groves); Eight-Angled Mysterious Ice Grass in flowers and ripe sweet berries where it is cold enough to snow; the Purple Flame Flower in ripe nether wart, fungi and roots of the Nether; the Illusionary Spirit Herb in flowers under the night sky (three times as often at full moon); Gold Lightning Bamboo in bamboo broken during a thunderstorm; the Ginseng Fruit in chorus plants of the End; the Yellow Essence Mushroom in mushrooms of the mushroom fields, the Deep Dark or below y 0. A Wood root or the Life Dao doubles the chance, a spiritual site raises it. Each herb carries its age: richer veins and sites give older herbs, and one in a hundred is ten times older; from 1,000 years its name turns gold. Divine Sense shows infused plants in green. Herbs cannot be planted. They go into pills, serve as auxiliary herbs (quality +age/3333, at most +0.30) and are worth 1 + age/100 CP. Sources: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 26, 150-151, 164, 276, 412, 433, 1174, 1194; Soul Land; Journey to the West ch. 24.
kultivator.screen.help.inti_binatang: Demonic beasts always leave a core of their tier and element (Low, Mid, High, King); bosses give a King core on the first kill of the day, ordinary monsters rarely a Low one, and the hunting expedition brings one home. Sneak-use a core to refine it: Low gives 3%% of your bar (at most 150) and toxin 6, up to King with 15%% (at most 25,000) and toxin 28; +50%% when the element is in your root, and comprehension for the Dao the element suits (Metal Sword, Fire Fire, Water and Ice Ice, Lightning Lightning, Earth Body, Wood Life, Wind Shadow, Space Space). Not while deviating. Use a core on your spirit beast to feed it (+60 to +1,000 beast cultivation, ×1.5 for a wolf with Lightning or Metal or a fox with Fire or Wood, every 10 s). Cores are alchemy catalysts, the Bone Tempering Pill needs an Earth core of Mid or better, and the Mission Hall pays 3 / 10 / 30 / 120 CP. Sources: Battle Through the Heavens ch. 11 and 14; A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 397 and 529; Coiling Dragon Book 8 ch. 57. Inspired by Tales of Demons and Gods ch. 13.
kultivator.screen.help.relik.title: Relics in Ancient Chests
kultivator.screen.help.relik: Chests of old structures now hold treasure as well: dungeons and mineshafts sometimes 1-4 Low stones; desert pyramids, jungle temples and strongholds 2-6 Low and a chance of a Mid; woodland mansions 1-3 Low; igloos Eight-Angled Ice Grass and jade slips of Ice arts; ocean ruins Low stones and Ice slips; Nether fortresses the Purple Flame Flower and Fire slips; buried treasure an old Illusionary Spirit Herb; ancient cities, bastions and End cities Mid stones with a chance of a High stone, a High Space core, a King Fire core or a Ginseng Fruit; ominous trial vaults a High stone. Divine Sense marks unopened chests within 24 blocks in gold. Only the loot tables change; no structure or block is touched. Sources: the items carry their own; jade slips from A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 1269; the spiritual sense from RMJ ch. 1269 and RMJ: Immortal Realm ch. 367.
kultivator.screen.help.alkimia_lanjut: The pot now holds 10 items and takes spirit stones, beast cores and spirit herbs. Up to two stones are catalysts (each Low +5%% success, each Mid or better +10%% and +0.1 quality); one core is a catalyst unless the recipe needs it (+5%% to +18%% success, and from Mid up the lowest quality: Mid, High, Perfect); one extra spirit herb, the oldest the recipe does not need, is the auxiliary herb (quality +age/3333, at most +0.30). Success never passes 95%%. New pills: Dao Insight (Illusionary Spirit Herb + Yellow Essence Mushroom + Echo Shard: +3 × quality comprehension, never above 60, 5 per realm), Toxin Purging (Eight-Angled Ice Grass + Honey Bottle + Spirit Grass: toxicity -35 × quality and ailments cleared), Enlightenment (Illusionary Spirit Herb + Glow Berries + Amethyst Shard: enlightenment chance ×2 for 10 minutes), Bone Tempering (Bone Block + Iron Ingot + Golden Carrot + an Earth core of Mid or better: +1 max health for good, Perfect +2, at most +10). Herbs also make Healing, Golden Core, Tribulation Warding and Soul Nurturing Pills. Refined Marrow Cleansing Pills carry a quality that scales their chance. Toxicity now weakens pills more steeply, fades faster while meditating, and above 90 a pill may backfire into a mild Qi Deviation. The Alchemy tablet (/kultivasi resep) lists every recipe and what your bag can refine. Sources: Battle Through the Heavens ch. 6, 9 and 14; A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 26-27, 131, 153 and 214; the Talisman Emperor glossary; Nine Star Hegemon Body Art ch. 53 and 503; A Will Eternal ch. 41; Keyboard Immortal ch. 1943.
